harbour_fisher.text: I used to row out of the harbour before dawn. Now I only say I did.
Two rivers meet at the harbour here, the Ystwyth and the Rheidol. The tide has opinions about both of them.

harbour_wife.text: Idris, do not be so twp, it is a coat and not a sail! Twp means a bit daft, you know. Said with love.
He has a boat in a bottle on every shelf. I counted eleven. I have given up counting.
